tools.name: company_info
tools.description: Facts about Klarframe: what it does, founders, location, languages, how projects are priced, contact and legal pages.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: All Klarframe products with a one-line summary and the product page URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one Klarframe product: what it is, how the rollout works, example scenarios, integrations, privacy and FAQ. Klarframe publishes no prices.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Keyword search over Klarframe product pages, guides (Ratgeber) and blog articles. Returns titles, URLs and a matching sentence. Covers topics such as AI phone assistants, meeting minutes, EU AI Act Article 50, GDPR and costs of AI models.

tools.name: get_intro_slots
tools.description: Free slots for a free 30-minute video intro call with the Klarframe founders (Monday to Friday afternoons, Madrid time). Returns ISO start times.

tools.name: prepare_intro_call
tools.description: Checks that an intro call slot is still free and returns a booking link with that slot preselected. Nothing is booked here: the person opens the link and enters name, company and email themselves.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_products, search_content · Private data: company_info · Public sink: prepare_intro_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_products, search_content · Private data: company_info · Public sink: prepare_intro_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
